candidate: Preserve Go nil versus allocated slices for GameServerStatus ports/addresses and PodSpec containers, without rewriting exact source fixture JSON.
evidence: Exact source GameServer fixtures contain status.ports=null and status.addresses=null; exact zero Fleet fixture contains spec.template.spec.template.spec.containers=null. Rust Vec rejects these before production defaulting. These three source JSON fields have no omitempty.
followup_required: Audit ListStatus.Values and PlayerStatus IDs nullable slice semantics under their own source-bound obligations; this patch does not certify every collection field.
next_review_trigger: After exact source fixture replay and affected controller/wire checks pass; refresh the SDK implementation gate.
rationale: Reuse one Option<Vec<T>>-backed GoSlice for the three concrete fields. Transparent serde preserves null versus [] and elements; slice reads/indexing retain their meaning, push creates a populated slice, and explicit Vec construction creates an allocated slice.
roi: The existing representation fixes a third directly blocking source field with one type substitution and compiler-guided Vec conversions. This avoids a second null-normalizing serde adapter or fixture rewriting. Constructor adaptations and controller/wire checks bound the cost; other collection compatibility remains required.
